name: filesystem_read_file
description: Read the complete contents of a UTF-8 text file from the workspace.

name: filesystem_search
description: Recursively search file contents with a regular expression and return matching lines with context.

include.description: Glob filter for paths to search.

context_lines.description: Lines of context around each match.

name: git_status
description: Return the working tree status as structured rows: staged, modified, untracked.

name: database_query
description: Run a read-only SQL query against the configured project database and return rows.

name: http_fetch
description: Fetch a URL and return the response body converted to markdown. For private or authenticated URLs use an authenticated MCP tool instead.
